method: e-rara OAI-PMH oai_dc (sets zuz, landkarten, cartesgeneve, museecarto) for discovery → IIIF Presentation 2.0 manifest per title for verbatim title, imprint, creators, holding institution, rights, thumbnail, canvas count and the stated "Kartendaten" extent, plus the provider's own canonical viewer URL from the DOI landing page (og:url); swisstopo WMTS 1.0.0 GetCapabilities for the Zeitreise, Siegfriedkarte and SWISSIMAGE Zeitreise editions and for the comparison layers in overlays.json. No title, date or coordinate is invented. Regenerate with: node scripts/fetch-records.mjs --out public/data

e-rara:zuz.rule: maps only, one entry per sheet, publication year ≤ 1900, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox

e-rara:landkarten.rule: every map of the set that is not a series volume, oldest first, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox

e-rara:cartesgeneve.rule: map records of the set, oldest first, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox

e-rara:museecarto.rule: map records of the set, oldest first, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox and a holding institution named by the manifest

swisstopo:zeitreise.rule: curated Zeitreise editions (exact or nearest advertised Time value)

swisstopo:hiks-siegfried.rule: one record per decade advertised in the Siegfriedkarte Time dimension (1870–1949)

swisstopo:swissimage-1946.rule: the dedicated SWISSIMAGE 1946 historical aerial layer
